description: Display a `Clear completed (N)` button below the list, where N is the current number of completed Todos. Selecting it removes every Todo with `done = true`; disable the button when N is zero.
acceptance_criteria: The bottom of the list always displays a button labeled `Clear completed (N)`
N reflects the current number of completed Todos in real time
When N is zero, the button is disabled and its hover text says `No completed Todos`
Selecting the button removes every Todo with done = true from both the list and localStorage
The order of incomplete Todos remains unchanged
